entries.description: An intentional community seeking revival, with ongoing projects in road and bridge construction, gardening, shelter building, and wood cutting. Offers camping space and seeks new resident members.
entries.raw_text: system of crop sharing/gardening. Ongoing projects include bridge and road construction, gardening, selecting and cutting wood, fencing, building campsites and shelters, and gathering materials. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 3 lesbians, land, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space (no sites), woods, farm land, women living and workin' on the land. Inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Continuation from previous page. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on 'We welcome: new members/residents' and collective work projects. Residents is 3 based on '3 lesbians' and 'women living and workin' on the land'. Focus on Farming/self-sufficiency based on 'crop sharing/gardening' and 'gardening, selecting and cutting wood, fencing'.

entries.land_location_as_stated: 25 miles NE of Palm Springs; in a rural desert area
entries.description: A 5-acre homestead in a rural desert area run by two lesbian feminist lovers of 15 years, raising vegetables, herbs, fruit trees, bees, chickens, and goats. They offer to share skills with rural-interested lesbians and welcome girl children.
entries.raw_text: ARLENE & ARLINE PO Box 511, Desert Hot Springs, CA 92240 (619)329-8916. (25 miles NE of Palm Springs in a rural desert area). We are two lesbian feminists, lovers of 15 years. We have been rural wimmin for 9 years, 3 years of which on our farm. We raise our own vegetables, herbs, chickens, goats, bees, fruit trees; many flowers. We live simply and creatively (no TV) and do enjoy sharing our skills with wimmin oriented lesbians (non-racist, non-classist etc) interested in rural life. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 5 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('two lesbian feminists, lovers of 15 years', '2 lesbians'). Residents is 2. Focus on Farming/self-sufficiency based on 'raise our own vegetables, herbs, chickens, goats, bees, fruit trees' and Workshops/education based on 'enjoy sharing our skills'. Land state CA inferred from contact address and '25 miles NE of Palm Springs'.

entries.description: A commercial dairy, cheeseplant, and homestead farm with six dwellings, greenhouse, pond, and pasture. The owner invites lesbians to lease operations or purchase shares, requiring experience in animal care and adherence to drug-free, ecological farming.
entries.raw_text: KIDS-LL-EAT IVY FARM 1220 Georgetown Rd, Cool, CA 95614 (916)823-3009. A thriving commercial dairy and cheeseplant, truck gardening, various homestead animals and horses. Six dwellings with all conveniences, spa, greenhouse, pond, barns, pasture. I welcome lesbians to lease out part of commercial operations or buy shares in the property. Requires money and responsibility. Must have country-living-animal experience and be interested, as well as believe in, ecologically run, woman owned commercial farming. NO DRUGS.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land because it is owned by a single woman offering leases or shares ('I welcome lesbians to lease out... woman owned'). Land address copied from street address. Recovery/substance-free coded from 'NO DRUGS'. Environmentalism/eco-friendly coded from 'ecologically run'. Farming coded from commercial dairy, cheeseplant, truck gardening, and homestead animals.

entries.description: A 120-acre cooperative farm of pacifists and vegetarians practicing permaculture, organic farming, and communal child raising. Men and women live and work on the land, welcoming new members, children, and visitors.
entries.raw_text: FOLLY FARM 9380 Hebo Rd, Grand Ronde, OR 97347 (503)879-5649. We are pacifists, vegetarians, and we practice organic agriculture, permaculture, and communal child raising. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 1 lesbian, 5 nonlesbians, 120 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women and men living and working on the land.
entries.notes: NOT WOMEN'S LAND. Preceded by editor note: 'NOTE: The following is not a women's land group, but it does welcome lesbians as visitors or members.' Land address copied from street address. Residents is 6 ('1 lesbian, 5 nonlesbians' and 'women and men living and working on the land'). Accepted groups include Gay men and Non-gay men because men are members living and working on the land. Environmentalism/eco-friendly from 'organic agriculture, permaculture'.

entries.description: A 10-acre resort and campground with lake frontage, housekeeping units, camper hook-ups, and recreational activities like swimming, canoeing, and skiing. Owned by a lesbian and welcoming women and children.
entries.raw_text: WILDERNESS WAY Box 176, Wascott, WI 54890 (715)466-2635. Wilderness Way is located on 10 wooded acres with 260 feet of lake frontage. There are 3 two bedroom housekeeping units each with fully equipped kitchen and bath, and living room area. The campground includes electric hook-ups, indoor bathroom facilities with hot showers and an indoor camper lounge area. Swimming, fishing, canoeing, bicycling, hiking, horseback riding and cross country skiing. Owned by 1 lesbian. Other lesbians active in planning special events and sharing management tasks. We welcome: nonlesbian women, girl and boy children, cats and dogs.
entries.notes: Listed under editor's note: 'NOTE: These groups don't have land, per se, or they aren't exactly land groups, but we included them for your information.' Wilderness Way is explicitly specified as a valid row in the codebook. Type is Retreat/Gathering Space as it operates as a campground/vacation facility. Land state WI from contact address.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in the Redwoods on the Mendocino Coast; 9 miles south of Mendocino
entries.description: A 2-acre wooded retreat on the Mendocino Coast offering a private rental cabin with detached shared bathroom facilities for visitors. Welcomes non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: PEPPERLAND PO Box 464, Albion, CA 95410 (707)937-0020. We have a quiet, private cabin with detached, shared, bathroom facilities, $20 per night (up to 3 people). We are in the Redwoods on the Mendocino Coast just 9 miles south of Mendocino. We welcome: nonlesbian women. We have: 2 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods.
entries.notes: Under the note for groups that do not have land per se, but qualifies as a row under the codebook rule for a guest house/cabin on its own 2 acres of land. Type is Retreat/Gathering Space based on offering a cabin rental for visitors ($20 per night). Land state CA from contact state and Mendocino location.
